Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't perform the action specified for "by X" in such an effect, the rest of the effect won't activate.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 or fewer security cards, can I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to activate  even if I don't place 1 [Leon Alexander] from my hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 [Leon Alexander] from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, if you have 3 or more security cards, gain 1 memory. If you have 2 or fewer, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gets +1000 DP.
